newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market steady at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with slaughter steers and heifers fully steady, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate.

Sales were confirmed on 1,200 slaughter steers and 300 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 97,000 head including 29,400 head or about 30 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 65.00, pen 65.50.
Confirmed - 1,500 last week - none last year - 13,200
